rationale: Final check confirms the official IM Creator product page documents a visual no-code editor, responsive layouts, templates, site design/publishing and bundled SEO tools. This is substantive conventional website-building evidence, but it is an overview rather than comprehensive core-plus-optional functionality coverage and does not establish the undated record's historical feature set. No credible AI functionality was found in the inspected source, but absence is not sufficient; preserve the adjudicated best-supported non-AI label as weak/forced.
version_scope: No version/date in source record. Current IM Creator page matches website-builder identity but is not exhaustive and cannot establish the historical represented feature set.
issues: Official overview does not exhaustively cover included optional features; no historic version; negative remains weak/forced.

sources.excerpt: Creating a website with IM Creator is simple, fast, and intuitive. Anyone can create a website in a matter of minutes, using our industry-leading editor. No coding necessary! ... Any content you add will be responsive ... choose a template ... Get comprehensive SEO tools out-of-the-box
sources.applicability: Official product page matches the record's website builder and substantiates conventional editing, responsive design, templates, and SEO; it does not cover all optional functionality or the historical version.

sources.excerpt: IM Creator is a cloud-based web development solution that allows individuals and businesses to create and maintain online stores, blogs, and HTML5 websites without writing code. It uses the WYSIWYG principle, and automatically generates cross-device, cross-browser compatible websites with built-in SEO tools.
sources.applicability: Frozen record identifies no-code WYSIWYG website creation and SEO, but is not an exhaustive inventory of AI functionality.
